name: VLAs Do Not Know When Not to Act
summary: Evaluates VLA behaviour under empty, neutral, nonsense, infeasible and wrong-task instructions from a fixed initial state, and compares three methods for suppressing the onset of motion.
numbers: 6 checkpoints all moved in every empty-instruction episode; safety prefix stopped 0 of 6; similarity gate held 5 of 6

why.cog: Tell that no task was given.
why.xr: Unrequested motion in a tabletop setting.
